evidence.excerpt: ICAROS addressed the calibration and incremental update of unsupervised anomaly detectors deployed on live SCADA networks. The project developed threshold calibration procedures for detectors operating without labelled attack data, incremental Gaussian mixture and autoencoder update algorithms suited to concept drift induced by planned process changes, and a set of evaluation protocols for comparing detectors across different ICS protocol environments. A labelled Modbus/TCP and DNP3 benchmark dataset was produced and released. Partners included a regional energy distributor that provided controlled access to a monitoring mirror port on an operational substation network, enabling validation under real traffic conditions. The project supported two doctoral candidates and produced nine peer-reviewed publications.
